title: The Final Settlement
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji announced the new order, a familiar voice echoed from the depths of the dimensional rift: "Chess piece, you have finally arrived here."

text.content: Above the Imperial Capital, a devastating pressure descended like tangible substance. The Settlement Envoy was surrounded by golden light more ancient than the stars—the fundamental power of the Old Heavenly Dao, the authority and will accumulated across countless epochs. "Chen Ji," the Settlement Envoy's voice reverberated between heaven and earth, "you think that broken Tianji Record can make you an enemy of the Heavenly Dao?" His gaze swept across the devastated battlefield, a cold smile curling his lips. "Before you stands the Sword of Settlement, forged by the Old Heavenly Dao with its final strength—with every struggle you make, it grows sharper."

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his chest pierced by that golden light with a fist-sized hole, his Heavenly Fate Value already fallen below the critical point. His consciousness began to blur, yet in those always-calm eyes, the arrogant outline of the Settlement Envoy was reflected. "What are you laughing at?" The Settlement Envoy stepped forward slowly, golden pressure pinning Chen Ji firmly in place. "You waste of a chess piece, even the Tianji Record can only glimpse three hours into the future—and I represent the eternal cycle of karma!" Chen Ji coughed up a mouthful of blood, yet at this moment, he laughed—that laughter was faint but clear.

dialogue.content: "Three hours..." Chen Ji slowly raised his head, and within those calm eyes surged an unprecedented light. "Three hours is enough for me to see your fate." His voice, though weak, carried a terrifying certainty. "Settlement Envoy大人, do you know that today, your thread of destiny should be severed?"

text.content: The Settlement Envoy froze for a moment, then burst into laughter, golden light shaking in all directions with his laughter. "Sever my thread of destiny?" He gazed down at Chen Ji as if looking at an ant. "I am the extension of the Old Heavenly Dao's will, my existence itself is karma—what can you use to sever it?" However, at this moment, from within Chen Ji's terrifying chest wound, a wisp of dark golden light slowly seeped out—that was Chen Nian's dormant Heavenly Fate blood sleeping within him—the core of the Fourth Possibility.

"The Fourth Possibility lies within your blood resonance with her." The words of the Demon Path commander echoed in Chen Ji's mind before his dissolution. He suddenly understood something—blood and that wisp of dark golden light intertwined in the void, sketching out a strange pattern. At the same time, the Twin Shadows within his body began to stir—that protective remnant left by his sister Chen Nian, now resonating with that dark golden Heavenly Fate blood. The Settlement Envoy's smile froze, for he felt a power beyond Heavenly Dao's expectations awakening.

choice.prompt: At the moment blood resonance was about to trigger, Chen Ji faced a crucial choice—the way this power was released would determine the final outcome's direction.

choices.text: Proactively detonate the Heavenly Fate blood
choices.description: Using oneself as the medium, proactively detonate the dormant Heavenly Fate blood, forcibly triggering blood resonance. This move might backfire on the self, but can achieve breakthrough at the fastest speed.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all remaining Heavenly Fate Value
choices.risk_hint: Success rate extremely high, but the cost is completely burning away one's foundation
choices.process_label: 陈机主动引燃天命之血

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He dove his consciousness into the dark golden light within his body, proactively detonating the dormant Heavenly Fate blood in a nearly self-destructive manner. In an instant, his body transformed into a radiant cocoon of light. The Twin Shadows left by Chen Nian spun wildly within the cocoon, generating intense resonance with that Heavenly Fate blood. The Settlement Envoy's expression finally changed—he felt a power sufficient to threaten Heavenly Dao's origin being bred within that cocoon.

The moment the light cocoon exploded, a figure slowly walked out—two overlapping Chen Jis, one black and one white, intertwined and merged like mirror images. The Settlement Envoy widened his eyes—he had never seen such a method of breakthrough. "Twin Shadows... merged into one?" His voice carried trembling for the first time. "Impossible! This exceeds Heavenly Dao's cognitive scope!"

choices.text: Wait for the Settlement Envoy's attack flaw
choices.description: Preserve the last thread of Heavenly Fate Value, wait for the moment the Settlement Envoy becomes arrogant and reckless,顺势完成血脉觉醒。顺着他的攻击之力完成突破，此方式更稳妥，但需要极致的耐心与判断。
choices.visible_reward: Complete the reversal when the opponent is most triumphant, psychological blow doubled
choices.risk_hint: Timing is crucial—mistakes could lead to utter destruction
choices.process_label: 陈机隐忍等待致命破绽

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, allowing the Settlement Envoy's golden pressure to continue crushing him. His body emitted sounds of bones shattering under the pressure, but those eyes always calmly watched every move of the Settlement Envoy. "What, still not begging for mercy?" The Settlement Envoy approached slowly, golden sword pressed against Chen Ji's throat. "This one can grant you a swift death." The moment he spoke these words, Chen Ji caught the subtle fluctuation in his breath—contempt, arrogance, and... a trace of impatient anxiety.

Now! Chen Ji's eyes flashed with sharp light. He no longer suppressed the surging power within his body, allowing the Settlement Envoy's attack to pierce his protective spiritual light. "You seek death!" The moment the Settlement Envoy's sword pierced Chen Ji's chest, that dark golden light erupted violently, swallowing both blade and the Settlement Envoy's arm. Chen Ji soared upward on that power, the Twin Shadows behind him completely merging, transforming into a yin-yang emblem covering half the sky.

"Observer's Origin—" Chen Ji's voice was no longer a single tone, but like the echoes of countless worlds overlapping, shaking heaven and earth. His eyes transformed into one black and one white pupil, each reflecting infinite possibilities of past and future. The Settlement Envoy's golden origin power actually began to crack before this force. "What... what kind of monster are you!" The Settlement Envoy retreated in horror—he never imagined that a waste he regarded as an ant could touch such a forbidden realm.

dialogue.content: "Monster?" Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, with each step his aura rising another level. "Settlement Envoy大人, you just called me waste, ant, chess piece—then what does it make you, driven to this state by a waste?" A cold smile curled at his lips—that smile held no anger, only pure, condescending mockery. "记仇不莽这句话，I waited too long for this. Today I shall show you what it means to settle accounts after autumn."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had completed his breakthrough, the Settlement Envoy's thread of destiny clearly visible. Now was the time to decide how to deal with this once-unparalleled representative of the Old Heavenly Dao.

choices.description: Using the Observer's source power to completely erase the Liquidation Envoy's thread of fate from the river of time, reducing both body and spirit to annihilation without a trace. This is the most efficient method of purging, and the most thorough liquidation.
choices.visible_reward: The Liquidation Envoy dissolved on the spot, completely intimidating the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance
choices.risk_hint: The disturbance is immense, potentially attracting the attention of other forces within the dimensional rifts
choices.process_label: 陈机斩断清算使命运线

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand, and in his palm emerged a thread of fate woven from countless points of light—that was the very foundation of the Liquidation Envoy's existence in this world. He flicked it gently, and those points of light scattered like fireflies blown apart by wind, dissolving into the void. "No—!" The Liquidation Envoy let out a mournful shriek as he watched his body turn to nothingness starting from his fingertips, inch by inch disappearing, "I am an extension of Heavenly Dao's will! You cannot do this to me!"

"Cannot?" Chen Ji watched the Liquidation Envoy's dissolution with perfect composure, his one black and one white eyes showing no trace of fluctuation, "Liquidation Envoy, weren't you just saying that I was trash, an ant, a chess piece? Then today, let this ant send you on your way." His voice was terrifyingly calm, as if merely stating an established fact. When the last strand of golden light dissolved, the oppressive weight pressing down on the imperial capital finally and completely lifted.

choices.text: Fate Severance: Preserve the Remnant Soul
choices.description: Sever the Liquidation Envoy's thread of fate while preserving a remnant soul, imprisoned within the Tianji Record. This is not only the ultimate humiliation for him, but also serves as a bargaining chip for dealing with remnants of the Old Heavenly Dao in the future.
choices.visible_cost: Requires Divided Consciousness to Suppress the Remnant Soul
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining an Important Bargaining Chip for Future Layouts
choices.risk_hint: The Remnant Soul May Seek Opportunity for Counterattack, Requires Constant Vigilance

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers gently hooked, drawing out most of the resplendent thread of fate from within the Liquidation Envoy, though not completely severing it. "No—" The Liquidation Envoy struggled weakly, "Give me a clean death!" Chen Ji shook his head, his expression carrying an almost merciful air. "A clean death? Liquidation Envoy, weren't you the one who wanted to give me a clean death just now?" He sealed that half-section of the fate thread into a blank page of the Tianji Record, "Rest assured, I will let you live well, watching as I dismantle the Old Heavenly Dao inch by inch."

The Liquidation Envoy's wails echoed within the Tianji Record, but soon transformed into a resentful sigh, then fell completely silent. Chen Ji closed the book's pages, feeling the imprisoned resentment and despair within, and a faint smile curved his lips. "You shall reflect well here." His voice drifted softly, yet it chilled the surrounding air several degrees, "When I think of you again, I shall decide whether to grant you a clean death."

Before the ripples of the Liquidation Envoy's dissolution had even settled, the remaining members of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance scattered throughout the imperial capital had completely collapsed. They had witnessed their greatest reliance, their most unyielding backing, reduced to nothingness or imprisoned within book pages by this disciple who had been deemed trash. Panic spread like a plague—some attempted to flee, others knelt in supplication, and yet more chose to end their own lives in despair. In an instant, the once-invincible alliance forces crumbled into nothingness.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji—" An aged yet authoritative voice rang out from among the alliance remnants. It was a white-haired elder, now slowly approaching at the head of dozens of core members. Though their steps were steady, terror and reverence that could not be hidden clouded every face. "We... are willing to surrender." The elder's voice trembled slightly, "The Old Heavenly Dao has perished. We are willing to serve the new order, to serve... the Observer." He struggled to utter those final two words, as if it had drained him of all his strength.

choice.prompt: Facing the surrender of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance's remnants, Chen Ji must make a decision—how to handle these former enemies will determine the tone of the new order.

choices.description: These people aided evil and had bloodstained hands. They cannot be kept. No amount of plea can change their past sins—uprooting the stumps is the only way to prevent future troubles.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing More Karmic Sins May Affect Future Cultivation Mindset
choices.visible_reward: Completely Eliminating All Possibilities of Old Heavenly Dao Restoration, Forever Preventing Future Calamity
choices.risk_hint: Excessive Killings May Trigger Vigilance and Hostility from Some Neutral Forces

text.content: Chen Ji looked at the kneeling elder with not a trace of pity in his eyes. "Surrender?" He laughed softly, that smile even colder than when he had dealt with the Liquidation Envoy, "Gentlemen, when you followed the Liquidation Envoy slaughtering all creation, did any of you think to surrender? Did those innocent souls you sacrificed as offerings ever have a chance to surrender?" He waved his hand lightly, and countless rifts tore open in the void behind him, from which poured dense threads of fate—the ironclad evidence of these people's past crimes that he had observed.

The elder's face turned ashen, his lips quivering as he tried to defend himself, yet he was frozen in place by a single glance from Chen Ji. "I do not kill you, not because I am merciful." Chen Ji's voice echoed through the imperial capital, clearly reaching every listener's ears, "But because you are still useful—I want you alive, to witness firsthand how the Old Heavenly Dao is completely buried, to personally experience the fear you once inflicted upon others." Before his words even finished, countless threads of fate had pierced through those core members' bodies, imprisoning them forever within their respective nightmares.

choices.description: These people, though they were once accomplices to tyranny, undoubtedly possess genuine talents among them. Offering them the chance to atone through meritorious service showcases the magnanimity of the New Order while simultaneously bolstering its strength.
choices.visible_cost: Requires constant vigilance and control, with the ever-present risk of rebellion
choices.visible_reward: Gains substantial human resources, strengthening the forces of the New Order
choices.risk_hint: Among them, there may still be hidden die-hard loyalists of the Old Heavenly Dao, representing potential dangers

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, his black-and-white eyes scanning across the kneeling crowd, as if examining lambs awaiting slaughter, or selecting usable chess pieces. "Do you wish to live?" His voice was calm, betraying no emotion. "Very well. But survival comes with a price." He raised his hand, and strands of destiny threads descended from the void, piercing into those people's brow centers. "From this day forth, your lives no longer belong to yourselves but to the New Order. The consequences of betrayal—you have just witnessed."

Everyone felt a sharp sting in their brow centers, followed by an invisible force binding their destinies firmly to that black-haired youth. They understood that from this moment, their life and death rested solely in Chen Ji's hands. "Th-Thank you, Observer, for sparing our lives!" The elder led the others in kowtowing, their voices carrying the relief of surviving catastrophe and profound reverence. Chen Ji ignored their gratitude, simply saying: "Don't be too quick to give thanks—loyalty isn't something spoken aloud. I'm giving you a chance to prove yourselves. Go and purge the die-hard elements among your former colleagues."

With the cleanup of the remaining forces complete, the dark clouds above the imperial capital finally scattered, and sunlight once again bathed this war-torn land. Chen Ji hovered mid-air, his black-and-white pupils reflecting the scene of ruins and rebirth beneath his feet. Behind him, the yin-yang totem formed by the fusion of the twin shadow figures slowly dissolved, yet that aura transcending Heavenly Fate still enveloped the entire imperial capital, with none daring to raise their heads for a direct glance.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze sweeping across every corner of the imperial capital—the surviving cultivators, the trembling mortals, the creatures crawling out from the ruins. In their eyes, there was fear, anticipation, confusion, but above all, a long-suppressed longing for rebirth. He knew that at this moment, everyone was waiting for him to speak, waiting for him to announce this world's future.

dialogue.content: "The Old Heavenly Dao has perished." Chen Ji's voice clearly echoed through the Three Realms and Six Paths, each word striking like thunder in everyone's hearts. "From this day forth, the fate of the Three Realms shall no longer be dictated by the高高在上的heavenly mandate, but written together by the Observer and all living beings." He paused, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "Someone asked me, what is the Observer? I tell you—the Observer is not a new Heavenly Dao, not a new dominator, but a guardian. What we guard is the right of all things to determine their own fates; what we sever is any hand that dares to treat sentient beings as chess pieces."

text.content: Throughout the imperial capital and beyond, countless cultivators and mortals fell to their knees. Some wept tears of joy, others stood in dazed bewilderment, while more—after enduring so much fear and despair—finally felt a flicker of genuine hope at this moment. Chen Ji observed all this, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. He recalled his journey of scheming and calculated moves, the allies and enemies who had perished, and Chen Nian—his sister, still dormant within his bloodline, awaiting the day she would be awakened.

"The Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance has been utterly destroyed today." Chen Ji's voice rang out again, carrying indisputable authority. "This one grants those who surrendered the chance to atone through meritorious service, offers those who repented the right to start anew—but should anyone dare to pay lip service while harboring treachery, secretly colluding with remnants of the Old Heavenly Dao..." His dual pupils suddenly radiated an intertwined light of black and white. "This Observer's threads of destiny are far keener than any enforcer's blade." At these words, those harboring delusions of rebellion all lowered their heads, not daring to show the slightest sign of unrest.

Just as Chen Ji announced the New Order, from the depths of the dimensional rift, a voice suddenly arose—that voice ancient and familiar, carrying a chilling calm, as if it had waited for this moment for ages. "Chess piece, you have finally arrived here." That voice penetrated the constraints of the dimensional rift, clearly reaching Chen Ji's ears, as well as every strong one capable of perceiving the rift's existence. Chen Ji's eyes abruptly narrowed, his black-and-white pupils reflecting the vague figure deep within the dimensional rift—that was...
